parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the container cluster.

parameters.name: ContainerFieldName
parameters.description:
The container search field. Valid values:

- **instanceId**: instance ID.
- **appName**: application name.
- **clusterId**: cluster ID.
- **regionId**: region.
- **nodeName**: node name.
- **namespace**: namespace.
- **clusterName**: cluster name.
- **image**: image name.
- **imageRepoName**: image repository name.
- **imageRepoNamespace**: image repository namespace.
- **imageRepoTag**: image tag.
- **imageDigest**: image digest.

parameters.name: ContainerFieldValue
parameters.description: The value of the container search field.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The query type. Valid values:

- **containerId**: container ID.
- **uuid**: asset ID.
